title: Local Legends: Nothing Bundt Cakes at Village at Newtown
summary: Watch Local Legends: Nothing Bundt Cakes at Village at Newtown and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog.
body_text: When local entrepreneurs build deep roots within their neighborhoods, entire retail centers benefit. Nothing Bundt Cakes at Village at Newtown shows exactly how. What began as a personal connection to a brand discovered out west became a bold entrepreneurial step, the first Nothing Bundt Cakes location in Pennsylvania. Eight years later, this bakery has grown into a true cornerstone of the center, known for its loyal following, steady foot traffic, and deep community ties. From day one, the response was overwhelming, lines out the door, customers eager to support a business that delivers more than cake. With a mission to “bring the joy,” Nothing Bundt Cakes has built lasting relationships by turning every visit into a meaningful interaction. It’s not just a transaction, it’s a celebration, a conversation, and a connection. Following the redevelopment of Village at Newtown, strategic merchandising and a thoughtful leasing vision created the right environment for community‑rooted operators like Nothing Bundt Cakes to thrive. When strong local and owner‑operated businesses choose our commercial retail space for lease, their success amplifies the performance of the entire center and strengthens neighborhood identity. Our approach delivers: ✔ Thoughtful redevelopment ✔ Smart tenant mix ✔ Leasing that boosts traffic and performance ✔ Community‑first operators who anchor long‑term value In this video, you’ll see: • How authentic customer engagement builds lasting loyalty • Why community‑connected operators drive consistent foot traffic • The importance of choosing the right location within your own community • How local ownership strengthens customer relationships • The impact of strategic merchandising and long‑term leasing vision Why it matters: Vibrant small businesses are more than tenants. They create joy, connection, and shared experiences. Their success strengthens shopping center performance and supports sustained long‑term value creation.

title: Teck and Anglo American announce future Anglo Teck Executive Leadership Team
summary: Vancouver, B.C. – Teck Resources Limited (TSX: TECK.A and TECK.B, NYSE: TECK) (“Teck”) and Anglo American plc (“Anglo American”) announce the composition of the future Executive Leadership Team (“ELT”) of Anglo Teck plc (“Anglo Teck”), the combined company that will be formed through the merger announced on September 9, 2025. These future ELT roles will take effect immediately following completion of the merger which is conditional upon receipt of final regulatory approval, expected within the originally announced timeline of between September 2026 and March 2027.
body_text: Vancouver, B.C. – Teck Resources Limited (TSX: TECK.A and TECK.B, NYSE: TECK) (“Teck”) and Anglo American plc (“Anglo American”) announce the composition of the future Executive Leadership Team (“ELT”) of Anglo Teck plc (“Anglo Teck”), the combined company that will be formed through the merger announced on September 9, 2025. These future ELT roles will take effect immediately following completion of the merger which is conditional upon receipt of final regulatory approval, expected within the originally announced timeline of between September 2026 and March 2027. Anglo Teck’s future ELT brings together a highly experienced and complementary set of leaders from both companies to shape a cohesive leadership culture with clear accountabilities. The future ELT combines deep operational and financial expertise and global market insight with a strong track record of safety leadership, values-based decision-making and project delivery to create enduring shareholder and stakeholder value. From the completion of the merger, the ELT of Anglo Teck will comprise: Duncan Wanblad – Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Jonathan Price – Deputy CEO & Chief Strategy Officer John Heasley – Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Ruben Fernandes – Chief Operating Officer (COO) Ian Anderson – Chief People Officer Lyndon Arnall – Chief Legal & Sustainability Officer Alison Atkinson – Chief Technical Officer and CEO of Crop Nutrients Karla Mills – Chief Projects Officer Matt Walker – CEO, Marketing Nolitha Fakude will continue in her current role, serving as Chair of Anglo Teck’s management board in South Africa, reporting to Duncan Wanblad. The regional leadership team responsible for the mining and production businesses is also confirmed and will report to Ruben Fernandes as COO, also with effect from completion of the merger: Brock Gill – CEO, Canada and U.S. Tony Power – CEO, Peru Ana Sanches – CEO, Brazil Dale Webb – CEO, Chile Mpumi Zikalala – CEO, Kumba Iron Ore Jonathan Price, President and CEO of Teck and Deputy CEO designate of Anglo Teck, said : “Today represents a significant next step in the creation of Anglo Teck, which we are setting up to be a top-tier global copper producer with world-class operations and exceptional growth opportunities. This executive leadership team will provide strong continuity for the combined business and positions us to unlock the full potential of Anglo Teck as a global leader in the responsible production of many of the metals and minerals that the world is counting on.” Duncan Wanblad, CEO of Anglo American and CEO designate of Anglo Teck, said : “Announcing Anglo Teck’s future Executive Leadership Team marks another major milestone as we progress towards combining these two great companies. Together, we are forming a global metals and minerals powerhouse offering investors more than 70% exposure to copper. As the incoming CEO of Anglo Teck, I have utmost confidence in the highly capable executive and regional leadership teams that I have set out today, benefiting from their track records of delivery and their diversity of global experience. I look forward to working with the team over the coming years, from our headquarters in Canada, as we establish Anglo Teck and deliver the significant value from this formidable combination.” The full composition of the Board of directors of Anglo Teck will be confirmed prior to completion of the merger1. As previously announced, Sheila Murray, currently Chair of Teck, will chair the Board of Anglo Teck, with Duncan Wanblad, Jonathan Price and John Heasley serving as executive directors. Richard Price, currently Chief Legal & Corporate Affairs Officer of Anglo American, will also join the Board of Anglo Teck as a non-executive director. 1 The Board of directors of Anglo Teck will be aligned with the commitments made under the Investment Canada Act . Tom McCulley, Chief Technical Officer of Anglo American, will serve as a Special Adviser to the CEO working on a number of ongoing technical and other programmes, prior to his planned retirement in 2027. Al Cook, CEO of De Beers, will also continue to report to the CEO while the sale of De Beers is completed. Jeff Hanman, Chief Strategy Officer of Teck, will serve as Chief Integration Officer and Nic Hooper will continue as Chief Corporate Development Officer, both reporting to Jonathan Price. Duncan Wanblad added: “When combining two companies and creating a new executive team, we inevitably have to make some difficult choices. For departing members of Anglo American’s and Teck’s ELTs, we will thank them for their exceptional contributions at the right time as they embark on the next stages of their lives and careers after the merger has completed. Until completion of our merger transaction, all current roles are unchanged and we are all focused on delivering our respective commitments, beginning with safety.” Anglo Teck – portfolio and value creation opportunities Anglo Teck will benefit from an industry-leading portfolio of producing operations, including several world-class copper assets, alongside high-quality premium iron ore and zinc businesses. Anglo Teck will be one of the world’s largest copper producers, and will benefit from some of the world’s highest quality copper endowments, with major brownfield and greenfield copper development projects located in attractive and well-established mining jurisdictions, to further grow the business. Anglo Teck will also retain growth optionality across its wider product portfolio, including in premium iron ore, zinc and crop nutrients. The merger is expected to deliver annual pre-tax synergies of approximately US$800 million by the end of the fourth year following completion of the transaction, with approximately 80% expected to be realized on a run rate basis by the end of the second year following completion, driven by economies of scale, operational efficiencies, and commercial and functional excellence. Anglo Teck will also work with key stakeholders and partners in the Collahuasi and Quebrada Blanca copper mines in Chile to optimize the value of these adjacent assets to realize US$1.4 billion (100% basis) of underlying EBITDA revenue synergies on an average pre-tax annual basis from 2030-2049, primarily through operational integration and optimisation of Collahuasi and Quebrada Blanca to create one of the world’s very best copper mining districts. Anglo Teck will have its global headquarters in Vancouver, Canada, where the CEO, deputy CEO, CFO and a significant majority of the senior management team will be based, supported by corporate offices in London and Johannesburg to serve its global operational footprint. Country offices and marketing hubs will continue to support the operational and commercial footprint of the combined business. All appointments will take effect on completion of the merger, with appropriate transition arrangements in place to ensure business continuity and effective handovers of responsibility. Footnote: Biographies of Anglo Teck’s future ELT: Duncan Wanblad Duncan has served as CEO of Anglo American since 2022 and brings more than 35 years of global mining experience. Duncan leads Anglo American’s ELT, having served as a member since 2009, and is chair of De Beers. From 2016 to 2022, Duncan was Group Director of Strategy and Business Development, also serving as CEO of the Base Metals business from 2013 to 2019. Between 2009 and 2013, Duncan ran a global portfolio of mining and industrial businesses for disposal or turnaround to maximize shareholder value. He was appointed CEO of Copper in 2008, prior to which he served as joint interim CEO of Anglo American Platinum. From 2004 to 2007, Duncan was Executive Director of Projects and Engineering at Anglo American Platinum. Duncan began his career at Johannesburg Consolidated Investment Company Limited in 1990. Duncan is a Fellow of the Royal Academy of Engineering. Jonathan Price Jonathan has served as Chief Executive Officer of Teck since 2022. He previously held the role of Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. Jonathan joined Teck in October 2020 and brings extensive experience in the resources sector through a variety of finance, commercial and business development roles spanning Europe, Asia and Australia, with a focus on strategy, transformational change and business improvement. Prior to joining Teck, Jonathan was Chief Transformation Officer and a member of the Executive Leadership Team of BHP, having previously worked for BHP in a number of its mining businesses and enterprise functions, occupying senior business development and finance roles in Asia, Australia and the UK. Prior to joining BHP in 2006, Jonathan worked in the Metals and Mining team at ABN AMRO and held various production and technical roles with Inco. John Heasley John has served as CFO of Anglo American since 2023 and has played a central role in Anglo American’s portfolio and performance transformation. John brings proven financial, strategic and commercial expertise, coupled with hands-on operational experience of supporting sustainable mining through technology. John is also a director of De Beers. Prior to joining Anglo American in 2023, he was chief financial officer and an executive director of The Weir Group PLC, the FTSE 100 global engineering company providing engineering technologies to the global mining industry, a role held since 2016. Prior to joining Weir in 2008, John served as group financial controller of Scottish Power plc, following his early career in professional services firms in audit, M&A, and corporate finance roles. John is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland. Ruben Fernandes Ruben has served as COO of Anglo American since 2025 and is responsible for ensuring safe and responsible operations, and optimising performance, future options and commercial value across Anglo American's portfolio. Ruben previously served as regional director for the Americas, CEO of Base Metals and CEO of Anglo American in Brazil. Ruben joined Anglo American in 2012 and was previously head of mining at Votorantim Metals in Brazil. Between 2009 and 2011, he was COO at Vale Fertilizers and, CEO of Kaolin Companies – Pará Pigments and Cadam – two Vale subsidiaries, between 2007 and 2009, and held various analysis, marketing and project roles in Vale’s Base Metals business which he joined in 1999. Ian Anderson Ian has served as Chief Commercial Officer of Teck since 2024, with responsibility for market and procurement strategies and performance, market and economic analysis, and external partnerships to advance the company’s strategic objectives and commercial success. With 25 years at Teck and with predecessor companies, Ian has held senior leadership roles spanning human resources, employee relations, operations, logistics and commercial functions. He has held key positions including General Manager of Line Creek and Fording River Operations, Vice President, Logistics, and Senior Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer, leading large teams, developing talent, and strengthening organisational culture and performance. Lyndon Arnall Lyndon has served as Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer for Teck since 2024, with responsibility for maintaining Teck’s leading sustainability performance and supporting the business through legal, risk and compliance functions. Lyndon has 29 years of experience in corporate, commercial, technology and resources law, and international experience from living and working in Singapore, the United States, Australia, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the UAE, South Africa and Egypt. He previously held the position of Group General Counsel at BHP. Prior to this, he held a number of senior legal positions with BHP, as well as strategic and legal roles with Infosys, Musanada, Barclays, Hewlett-Packard and IBM. Alison Atkinson Alison leads Anglo American’s Projects and Development team, also responsible for carbon and innovation, having joined Anglo American in 2023. Alison leads the development and delivery of Anglo American’s major capital projects, including the Sakatti polymetallic underground project in Finland, the filtration plant project at Minas-Rio in Brazil and, in South Africa, the UHDMS plant at Kumba and the 1GW Envusa renewable energy investment. Alison was previously CEO of AWE plc from 2020, a technology company that assures, designs, manufactures, and assembles capabilities and products that support the UK's nuclear defence programme. During her 18 years at AWE, she ran many aspects of the business, including operations, major projects and technology programmes. Prior to AWE, Alison spent 14 years at Halcrow, managing projects worldwide, servicing both the public and private sectors. Alison is also a non-executive director of Kier Group plc and chair of its ESG committee. Alison is a Fellow of the Royal Academy of Engineering. Karla Mills Karla has served as Chief Project Development Officer for Teck since 2024, with responsibility for accelerating growth by advancing Teck’s project delivery, including leading execution of major capital projects such as the Highland Valley Copper Mine Life Extension and advanced greenfield projects including Zafranal in Peru, and San Nicolás in Mexico. Karla joined Teck in 2013 as Program Manager, Water Treatment Projects. She was appointed Program Director, Water Treatment Projects, in 2017; Vice President, Project Development, in 2018; and Senior Vice President, Projects in 2023. Karla has more than 25 years of project development experience, including 16 years with Wardrop Engineering and Tetra Tech Mining and Minerals, where she held numerous progressively more senior roles in project, portfolio and corporate leadership. Matt Walker Matt has served as CEO of Anglo American’s Marketing business since 2023, optimising the value of the Group’s products in the market through the implementation of effective sales and trading strategies. Matt is also a director of Kumba iron Ore and De Beers. Prior to taking up this role, Matt was Group Head of Corporate Finance, leading capital allocation and integrated planning, as well as the M&A transaction team. Between 2019 and 2021, he served as Group Treasurer responsible for the Group’s bank and debt market funding. Matt joined Anglo American in 2007 and has held a number of senior finance and other roles across the Group, including as CFO of the Copper business in Chile. About Teck Teck is a leading Canadian resource company focused on responsibly providing metals essential to economic development and the energy transition. Teck has a portfolio of world-class copper and zinc operations across North and South America and an industry-leading copper growth pipeline. Teck is focused on creating value by advancing responsible growth and maintaining resilience built on a foundation of stakeholder trust. Headquartered in Vancouver, Canada, Teck’s shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbols TECK.A and TECK.B and on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol TECK. About Anglo American Anglo American is a leading global mining company focused on the responsible production of copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients – future-enabling products that are essential for decarbonising the global economy, improving living standards, and food security. Our portfolio of world-class operations and outstanding mineral endowments offers value-accretive growth potential across all three businesses, positioning us to deliver into structurally attractive major demand growth trends. Our integrated approach to sustainability and innovation drives our decision-making across the value chain, from how we discover new resources to how we mine, process, move and market our products to our customers – safely, efficiently and responsibly. Our Sustainability Strategy commits us to a series of stretching goals over different time horizons to ensure we build trust as a corporate leader, contribute to a healthy environment and help create thriving communities. We work together with our business partners and diverse stakeholders to unlock enduring value from precious natural resources for our shareholders, for the benefit of the communities and countries in which we operate, and for society as a whole. Anglo American is re-imagining mining to improve people’s lives. Anglo American is currently implementing a number of major structural changes to unlock the inherent value in its portfolio and thereby accelerate delivery of its strategic priorities of Operational excellence, Portfolio optimisation, and Growth. The sale of our steelmaking coal and nickel businesses and the separation of our iconic diamond business (De Beers) continue to progress and once completed, will focus Anglo American on its world-class resource asset base in copper, premium iron ore and crop nutrients. www.angloamerican.com Investor Contact: Edwin Shadeo Acting Vice President, Investor Relations and Treasurer 604.699.4531 edwin.shadeo@teck.com Media Contact: Dale Steeves Director, External Communications 236.987.7405 dale.steeves@teck.com 26-17-TR

title: Moments: More Ways to Discover Your Next Favorite Game on Roblox
summary: Roblox launches new homepage with tabs for Moments, Chat, Me
body_text: Share News Product Moments: More Ways to Discover Your Next Favorite Game on Roblox Roblox’s App Now Offers Chat, Play, Discovery, and Creation in One Place By Seb Barrios, Senior Vice President of Engineering Published Jul 28, 2026 Today, players opening Roblox in Canada, New Zealand, and Singapore will begin to see a new app home, with tabs for Moments, Chat, and Me (those in New Zealand will also see Build ). Tabs will roll out globally* over the next several months. Moments is a new way to discover games: Players can watch gameplay clips from friends and video content creators, jumping into a fun game with one tap. Every Moment is a doorway to play. Chat lets players have one continuous conversation that travels seamlessly with them into a game—without leaving Roblox. Me brings avatar and profile into one place, making it easier for players to express themselves. Starting today, players in Canada, New Zealand, and Singapore will begin to see a new Roblox app with tabs for Moments, Chat, and Me. These tabs will roll out globally* over the coming months. For players in New Zealand, the new Build tab , an extension of Roblox Studio offering mobile-first creation in the app, will also begin to appear today. Every day, an average of 132 million active users come to Roblox looking to play one of millions of available games. And every day, our creator community releases even more games to try, from simulator and strategy games to high-fidelity, immersive multiplayer worlds. By matching players to the games they’ll truly enjoy and come back to again and again, we help creators build their business and find their most engaged audiences. Outside of Roblox, people may chat or share games in places where friends have to click three times and install an app to start playing. We want players to be able to recommend, discover, and find games all in one place without the extra steps. So we’re expanding the Roblox app to support the entire flow—one place to chat with friends, see what others are playing, and click directly into a great game. Earlier this year, we optimized our discovery and recommendation systems for games players stick with, surfacing relevant games on Roblox’s homepage via a player’s Recommended for You section. When Moments first launched as a beta, we envisioned it as an additional engine for game discovery. Today, Moments becomes a dedicated tab* on Roblox. With a diverse set of content from players and video content creators. Moments creates a frictionless way to see a game and play it with just one tap. Moments: Discover and Play New Games Instantly Moments is designed as a direct path from an exciting game to the people who will love it. Age-checked players 16 or older* can discover gameplay videos shared by friends and other players and try the game themselves with just one tap. Brand-new in the Moments tab are high-quality Roblox content videos by select content creators, similar to the content that players see these content creators sharing elsewhere. But in Moments, these videos not only share gameplay highlights, they link directly to the games they feature, so players can start playing with a single tap. As with our other discovery systems , Moments is optimized for players to connect with the games they will love and come back to. In the Moments tab, every post is a doorway to play. Players can click the Join button beneath each gameplay clip to start playing immediately. That’s the road to discovering a great new game. Chat: Connect and Play Across Games Chat is where players go to recommend games to friends, coordinate a play session, even jump into a game together. This matters because people don’t come back just for a game, they come back to connect and play with friends. When a friend says, “Hey, you have to try this game,” we want joining that game to be as easy as possible. Today, the Chat tab will appear for all chat-eligible players. Soon, we’ll make it possible for the conversation to continue within and across games so friends can stay seamlessly connected as they play without switching apps or coordinating on different devices. Built atop foundational features like age-checks to chat and Roblox Kids and Select accounts , Chat is available only when it's age-appropriate for players. With Trusted Friends and real-time chat rephrasing , we’re making it easier for players of all ages to connect—with the protections that help keep them safe. Me: Self-Expression, All in One Tab The Avatar tab is now the Me tab, making it simple to update a player’s profile information and their avatar’s look all in one place. Here, players can choose from several new avatar backgrounds, giving them one more way to express themselves. Build: Expanding What’s Possible on Roblox The public alpha of the Build tab, our new in-app creation feature , starts rolling out today to age-verified users 9 and older in New Zealand. Build is a mobile-first game-creation experience designed to work alongside Studio and share the same back end, models, and chat history. Starting today, public alpha creators can start a game on their phone in Build, then finesse it with the broader capabilities of Studio. Once the tab is fully launched, they’ll also be able to start in Studio and check on progress on their mobile device. With Build, we’re expanding not only the kinds of games Roblox supports, but who can create them. This is the beginning of a new chapter for Roblox players, with one home for connecting with friends, discovering what their friends and favorite video content creators are playing, expressing themselves, and maybe even building something entirely new. We can’t wait to see what the community does with it. * Availability and features will vary by age and region.

While manufacturers continue improving flight time, payload capacity, and onboard AI, the real bottleneck is increasingly becoming wireless signal communications—the ability to move massive amounts of […]
body_text: Peraso Solving the Drone Bottleneck: It’s Not the Flight It’s the Signal Posted on July 13, 2026 As the global drone, AI infrastructure, and autonomous systems markets accelerate, the industry's next major challenge is shifting from keeping drones in the air to keeping them securely connected. While manufacturers continue improving flight time, payload capacity, and onboard AI, the real bottleneck is increasingly becoming wireless signal communications—the ability to move massive amounts of mission-critical data securely, reliably, and in real time across increasingly crowded and contested environments.

title: How to Use AI in Marketing: A Guide for Small Business Owners
summary: Learn how to use AI in marketing to get found, win leads, and drive repeat business. A practical, step-by-step guide for small business owners.
body_text: A homeowner fills out your contact form on Saturday night after their water heater fails. By the time you see the message Monday morning, they’ve already hired someone else. That kind of missed opportunity happens every day. Leads sit unanswered, review requests get forgotten, social media goes quiet, and your business becomes harder to find online. It’s rarely because you don’t care. Your day fills up quickly, and marketing often gets pushed aside. Learning how to use AI in marketing starts with solving these problems. AI can respond to inquiries, request reviews, create AI-generated social posts, and follow up with customers so you have more time to serve them. You don’t need to learn a dozen new tools or become a marketing expert. Start with one task that’s slowing your business down, prove it works, and build from there. In this guide, you’ll learn practical ways to use AI in your marketing, what tasks to automate first, and how Thryv® helps small businesses attract more customers, win more jobs, and drive repeat business with less manual work. Key Takeaways AI helps small businesses get found online, respond to leads faster, and bring customers back. Start by automating the task that’s costing you the most customers, such as review requests or lead follow-up. Fast responses and consistent follow-up help you win more jobs before customers choose another business. AI delivers the most value when your listings, reviews, website, and customer communication work together. What “Using AI in Marketing” Actually Means for a Small Business For a small business, using AI in marketing means letting software handle the repetitive work that often gets pushed to the bottom of your to-do list. That could be drafting a social media post, writing a blog post, sending a review request, following up with a new lead, or organizing customer information so you know who to contact next. Those tasks still get done while you’re focused on serving customers. Imagine you finish a water heater installation and head straight to your next appointment. Instead of needing to remember to request a review that evening, AI can send a personalized message while the experience is still fresh. A few more reviews each month can improve your visibility in local search results, strengthen your SEO (search engine optimization) efforts, and give future customers more confidence to call. Some AI tools use generative AI for content creation, while others automate follow-ups, reminders, and customer communication after you’ve set them up. More than 80% of small businesses already use artificial intelligence in marketing. The biggest opportunity comes from connecting those tools so you spend less time switching between apps while maintaining brand control. Keeping everything in one place makes day-to-day marketing much easier. For example, after you complete a plumbing repair, Thryv’s AI Content Assistant uses generative AI to turn your job details into a ready-to-publish social post, CaptionAI formats the caption for each platform, and Automated Reviews sends a personalized review request automatically. You approve the messaging before it goes live, giving you confidence that every piece of content reflects your business. How to Use AI to Get Found Online (Listings, Local SEO, Reviews) Customers can’t hire your business if they can’t find it. One of the easiest ways to improve your visibility is by keeping your online listings and Google Business Profile accurate and active. Incorrect business hours, phone numbers, or addresses can cost you calls. AI-powered business listings management software helps keep your information accurate across major directories. Posting updates, adding photos, and answering customer questions keeps your business looking active. After completing a landscaping project or plumbing repair, Thryv’s AI Content Assistant can turn your job details into ready-to-publish social posts, so your online presence stays current without starting every post from scratch. Reviews also play a major role in whether customers choose your business. Imagine two plumbers showing up in local search. One has recent five-star reviews with thoughtful responses. The other hasn’t received a new review in months. Many homeowners will call the business that appears more active and trusted. If collecting reviews has been inconsistent, Thryv’s Automated Reviews can send review requests automatically after each completed job, while AI Review Response helps draft personalized replies you can review before publishing. That keeps your online reputation growing without adding another item to your to-do list. Your website deserves attention, too. Thryv’s AI Website Builder helps create service pages, location-specific content, and FAQs built faster and SEO/AEO-optimized content that helps your business get found in Google Search, ChatGPT, and voice search. The same approach works for blogs, emails, and social media if you’re learning how to use AI for content creation across your business. Download the Guide to AI for Small Business Want the deeper playbook? Our free guide walks through practical, owner-ready ways to put AI to work across your marketing. GET FREE GUIDE How to Use AI to Convert More Leads (Lead Generation, Follow-Ups) Every missed follow-up is a job someone else books. A customer who fills out your contact form during lunch or sends a Facebook message after work usually expects a quick response. If they don’t hear back, they’ll often contact the next business on their list. AI helps prevent those missed opportunities by capturing every inquiry, responding quickly, and keeping follow-up moving until a customer books. Instead of relying on memory or handwritten notes, every lead stays organized, and every opportunity has a better chance of becoming revenue. Using AI for Lead Capture Leads come from phone calls, website forms, live chat, social media, and Google Business Profile. When they’re scattered across different places, it’s easy to miss one. Once it’s set up, Thryv’s AI Lead Insights captures those inquiries in one place and uses lead scoring to help identify which ones need immediate attention. For example, someone requesting emergency drain service today should probably be prioritized over someone requesting a remodeling estimate next month. If you’re finding it difficult to keep track of new inquiries across multiple channels, resources about AI tools for business development can help you understand how AI supports lead management. Thryv’s AI Lead Insights automatically captures missed calls, website forms, chats, and messages in one place, then uses machine learning and lead scoring to identify the inquiries most likely to become booked jobs and recommends a clear next step for each one. Automating Follow-Up Many customers don’t book the first time they reach out. They get busy, compare estimates, or forget to call back. Once it’s set up, AI sends timely follow-up emails or texts on schedule, creating consistent email marketing and customer communication without adding another task to your day while keeping your marketing workflows moving even when your schedule is full. title: Is a home equity loan a good idea?
summary: A home equity loan is a good idea only if you have a structured repayment plan and use the funds to increase your net worth or save on interest.
body_text: A home equity loan tends to make sense when the funds are used to strengthen your financial position or add lasting value. Financing home improvements Home renovations are among the most common and most justified uses of home equity. Projects that increase your property's value, like kitchen remodels or structural repairs, can deliver a meaningful return. As a bonus, interest may be tax-deductible if you use the funds to buy, build, or substantially improve your home. Check with a qualified tax professional before assuming your interest qualifies. Consolidating high-interest debt Replacing high-interest credit card balances with a single, lower fixed-rate home equity loan can reduce what you pay in interest and simplify your monthly obligations. The trade-off: you're converting unsecured debt into debt backed by your home, so consistent repayment is essential. Covering emergency or major expenses When urgent costs arise like medical bills, critical home repairs, a home equity loan can provide stability at a lower rate than most other borrowing options. It's best used as a last resort, with a clear plan to repay. Enjoying fixed rates and predictable payments Unlike a home equity line of credit (HELOC), a home equity loan typically carries a fixed rate and term. Your monthly payments stay consistent, making it easier to plan and budget over the life of the loan. A home equity loan can become a financial burden when used for the wrong reasons or under the wrong conditions. Discretionary or luxury spending Using your home as collateral for vacations, weddings, or other non-essential expenses puts long-term equity at risk for short-term wants. Your home's equity represents years of built-up value — spending it on depreciating experiences rarely pays off. Financial instability or high debt load If your income is unpredictable or you're already managing significant debt, adding another monthly payment could strain your budget and put your home at risk. A stable income, manageable debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, and existing emergency savings are the baseline before taking on a home equity loan. Falling home values If property values decline after you borrow, you could end up owing more than your home is worth — a situation known as negative equity. This can limit your ability to sell or refinance until values recover. No clear repayment plan Borrowing without a defined strategy can backfire. Using home equity to replace one debt with another isn't progress unless the new terms meaningfully improve your position. Know exactly how you'll use and repay the funds before signing. Your home is collateral Because the loan is secured by your home, missed payments can lead to foreclosure — a legal process in which the lender takes ownership of your property. Only borrow what you're confident you can repay. Fees and closing costs Expect costs like appraisal fees, closing costs, and possibly prepayment penalties. Factor these into your total borrowing expense when comparing options. Temporary credit score impact Taking on a large loan can temporarily lower your credit score by increasing your overall debt load. This typically recovers over time with consistent on-time payments. Axos home equity loans Put your home's equity to work. A home equity loan from Axos lets you borrow against the value you've built; with a fixed rate, predictable payments, and no surprises. Ideal for major renovations where you need a lump sum upfront. Apply Now Learn More A home equity loan isn't the only way to access funds. Depending on your situation, one of these may be a better fit: HELOC: Offers flexibility for ongoing or phased expenses, with a variable rate and the ability to draw funds as needed to a set limit. Personal loan: Unsecured and faster to qualify for in some cases, though it typically carries a higher interest rate. Cash-out refinance: Replaces your existing mortgage with a new, larger one — giving you a lump sum upfront but resetting your loan term. Home improvement loans or grants: Designed specifically for renovations and sometimes available through state or local programs. Is a home equity loan a good idea? For homeowners with stable income, solid credit, and a clear plan, it can be one of the most cost-effective ways to fund major expenses or reduce high-interest debt. For those in uncertain financial positions or without a defined repayment strategy, the risks outweigh the benefits. Take time to compare lenders, review your full financial picture, and consider speaking with a financial advisor before making a decision. Ready to explore your options? Learn more about home equity loans from Axos and find out how much you may be able to borrow. Frequently asked questions How much can I borrow with a home equity loan? Most lenders allow you to borrow up to 80–85% of your home's appraised value, minus what you still owe on your mortgage. The exact amount depends on your equity, credit profile, and the lender's requirements. What's the difference between a home equity loan and a HELOC? A home equity loan gives you a lump sum at a fixed rate — predictable and straightforward. A HELOC works more like a credit card: you draw funds as needed up to a limit, usually at a variable rate. Home equity loans suit defined, one-time expenses; HELOCs work better for ongoing costs. Is a HELOC better than a home equity loan? It depends on how you plan to use the funds. For a single large expense with a known cost, a home equity loan's fixed rate offers more stability. For projects with uncertain or phased costs, a HELOC's flexibility may be more practical. What can I use a home equity loan for? Common uses include home renovations, debt consolidation, medical expenses, and education costs. The strongest use cases are those that add long-term value or reduce what you're paying in interest elsewhere.

summary: Kazia is an Australian oncology company developing innovative, high-impact drugs for cancer. Our lead program is paxalisib, which is being developed to treat glioblastoma, the most common and most aggressive form of primary brain cancer in adults.
body_text: Recent Posts Kazia Therapeutics says diversification is the key to drug development Kazia Therapeutics’ oncology drug paxalisib continues to generate positive trial data Kazia Therapeutics' promising data on treatment targeting brain metastases to be presented at conference Kazia Therapeutics forms new Scientific Advisory Board with world-leading experts in brain cancer Kazia Therapeutics gains US FDA Rare Paediatric Disease Designation for paxalisib in rare form of childhood brain cancer Archives August 2022 July 2022 June 2022 May 2022 April 2022 February 2022 December 2021 November 2021 October 2021 September 2021 July 2021 April 2021 February 2021 December 2020 October 2020 September 2020 August 2020 July 2020 June 2020 May 2020 Categories GENERAL MEDIA RELEASE Uncategorized Oncology-focused drug development company Kazia Therapeutics (ASX: KZA) has recruited its first patient into a Phase II study of investigational new drug paxalisib for the treatment of newly-diagnosed and recurrent glioblastoma. title: Carrot launches first-of-its-kind global doula network: Trusted support for pregnancy & postnatal care
summary: Learn about Carrot's global doula network and how it's bridging the maternal-health gap — for safer pregnancies and lower costs.
body_text: From skyrocketing cases of postpartum depression to a troubling increase of maternal mortality in the U.S., the truth is clear: we are in the midst of a global maternal-health crisis. This crisis is fueled by a broken healthcare system that has historically deprioritized women’s health during one of the most critical moments in their lives. The need for deeper, more attentive care is paramount, and doulas can bridge the gap. Doulas are non-medical professionals who provide vital education, advocacy, and emotional support for people who are pregnant, giving birth, and recovering from labor. Research shows that engaging a qualified doula during or after pregnancy can: Improve live-birth rates Reduce the frequency of expensive C-sections Lower rates of postpartum depression and anxiety Decrease complications in labor and delivery Shorten recovery time from labor, getting parents back to work sooner But not all doulas are created equal, and there isn't a standardized vetting process to ensure quality care from one professional to another. This quality gap can create risks to the health and safety of women, babies, and families. Carrot has always recognized the valuable role these caregivers play, by helping our members afford and access their services. And now, we’re making it even easier to connect with the most trusted professionals in this field. Carrot is proud to announce our new doula network : a global, in-network program of highly qualified caregivers — rigorously vetted by Carrot — to ensure the highest quality experience for every member. Members can now more easily access the best professionals possible for prenatal and postnatal care, because all doulas within Carrot's network complete a rigorous vetting process. The benefits of Carrot’s doula network By building our doula network, Carrot offers value to members and employers alike: Cost savings: Carrot’s doula network eliminates erroneous claims, meaning customers can rest easy knowing the services truly add value for members. Global access: The doula network is currently available in the U.S., the U.K., Canada, Germany, Ireland, India, and Australia — with plans to expand to even more countries in the near future. Carrot’s global eye ensures in-network doulas meet the same criteria, no matter where they practice. Peace of mind: Carrot is the only solution that offers a curated network of highly trained, vetted doula professionals. Members can connect with the very best support for their needs the first time, instead of having to search independently and hope for the best. Virtual and in-person care: Members can connect virtually with doulas or find a provider in their local community, expanding the reach of this life-changing care. Healthier pregnancies: Doula support has been shown to reduce unnecessary interventions and improve the mental health of future and postpartum parents, all of which means better outcomes for all. Trusted care, the first time Carrot is committed to providing the best possible support for our members and looks forward to the positive impact these enhancements will have on pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum care. By connecting members with trusted caregivers and reducing their financial burden, we’re building toward this future every day.
